title: Malaysian Curry Dishes
description: A flavorful and aromatic Malaysian-inspired curry dish, perfect for adventurous foodies. This recipe combines the rich flavors of spices and the tender texture of chicken.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic and sauté until softened.
Add chicken and cook until browned.
Add curry powder and stir for 1-2 minutes.
Add coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Stir in curry leaves and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add fish sauce and honey (if using) and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
